'''Paul Todd Feldman''' (DRTORCH) was a World Finalist in 1996, 1997, 1999, and 2000. He also played the [[2025 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-04-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-may-to-july-2025/ 2025 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org</ref>
